title: Fit a mixture, tie triphones, and scale posteriors
brief: Fit a diagonal Gaussian mixture with EM, tie triphone states by likelihood gain, and decode scaled likelihoods with Viterbi.
hints: Start means at evenly spaced ranks of np.argsort(X[:, 0], kind='mergesort'). The shared variance is X.var(axis=0), divisor N, then floored.
Responsibilities are a softmax of log(weight) plus the diagonal Gaussian log density. scipy.special.logsumexp runs over components.
A triphone is f'{left}-{phone}+{right}'. Both ends of the string use the boundary, default sil. count_unseen counts every missing occurrence.
Gain is loglik(yes) + loglik(no) - loglik(all). An empty side scores 0. scaled_likelihoods divides by the prior. viterbi uses log_A[i, j] = log P(j | i), the same layout as the HMM chapter.
